mainline_parent.primary_stop: 5 repeated seed-identity keys in one anomalous Rhamnus station; strict primary sowing analysis still STOP

evidence_exposure: Sowing outcomes and published paper are already exposed; germination and one/two-summer witness counts in PR #709 are known. This cross-stage planting analysis is post hoc and MUST NOT be advertised as independent blinded confirmation. Planting survival individual rows have not been examined in this protocol-writing step.

focal_units.unit: species × patch; forest patch geographic clustering unit (n=10); planted sapling is a nested individual not an independent landscape
focal_units.natural_status: site_type as original source classification; not a detection-corrected current distribution
focal_units.denominator: all distinct species × site combinations with site_type='absent' (and 'present' as descriptive comparator) in sowing CSV, with full source-specific missing flow; no outcome-based filtering
focal_units.observed_witness: one or more unambiguously identified confirmed positives in source rows; no positive means 'not witnessed', NEVER a viability impossibility conclusion
focal_units.planting_structure: 299 expected planting records; require nonempty species/site/site_type, numeric individual id and station; duplicate (species,site,station,id) is SCIENTIFIC_STOP unless original author code identifies a different explicit key; survival code is 0/1/NA, NA not interpreted as death
focal_units.naturally_absent_bypass_witness: If a seed in unprotected station survives first/second summer at naturally absent patch, or independently transplanted sapling survives first summer, this falsifies strict zero early-stage survival possibility in that planted microsite, not historical dispersal, full life-cycle establishment, or population viability.
focal_units.full_source_quality: Keep all five repeated seed keys and 50 anomaly-arm seed rows quarantined for sowing witnesses; no reconstruction, inferred treatment relabeling, or complete-panel directional conclusion

preregistered_descriptive_tables: All naturally absent species × patch units: germ-only; first-/second-summer unprotected sown witnesses; planted first-summer witnesses; intersections and unmatched source coverage
Natural-present units the same table; no pooled independence claim
Forest-patch distribution of unique naturally absent species × patch positive witnesses at each life stage
Number of sown-first-summer-unwitnessed units with a positive independent planted-sapling witness, plus the converse; absence of witness never interpreted as zero survival
Concordance between preexisting unaffected 51 unit robust protection sign classes and direct unprotected early-survival witnesses: purely post-exposure, no new inference hypothesis test.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify PR #709 source SHA, quality STOP, 51 unaffected unit ±0.025 germination effect classifier, or frozen EOG-WF endpoint count
Do not interpret planting as a protected/unprotected treatment; it has no such field.
Do not equate sapling transplant survival with sown-seed survival or compare rates directly across stages.
Do not select denominator or taxa after looking at planting survival results.
Do not claim source processes A/B/M separately identified or natural seed dispersal actually observed.
Do not use seed counts as independent geographic replication or post hoc p values.
validation: Refetch original user-supplied ZIP and compare all 12 SHA256 and sizes against frozen official manifest before reading outcomes.
Require README declared planting file columns and reject duplicate specimen identifiers and inconsistent site_type across source tables.
Independent recomputation of marginal witness presence using strict boolean any() and site-species keys.
Exact status SOURCE_QUALITY_STOP maintained for anomalous sowing arm.
Store all groups including missing planting matches as explicit categories; audit sums to the source roster.
interpretation: Separate stages of realized viability can be identified without recovering the historical mechanism of natural absence; this is an ecological observation under human propagule introduction, not a new theorem, an independent outcome-blinded test, or proof of dispersal-limited causality.
